title: Sapient
summary: Self-custody wallet for Ootle mainnet and Esmeralda. November 27, 2026: the Chrome Web Store lists version 0.11.3, updated November 25; its older testnet-only overview conflicts with the current creator site, which explicitly offers mainnet and Esmeralda switching. Separately, Android 0.11.3 was published November 26 for Android 10 or newer. Its notes describe fixing Make public after shielding the whole balance and restoring privacy actions for imported accounts, using Ootle SDK 0.6.4. These are creator release claims, not tests performed here. Firefox and iOS submissions mentioned by the creator are not treated as available store releases. No package or extension was downloaded or installed and no wallet or transaction was operated. The new genuine recording shows the Android release announcement; Chrome and Android versions are tracked separately.
cardSummary: Manage Ootle accounts with Sapient’s browser wallet, or explore its Android release with NFT and token tools.
